findings.finding: The basis overstates source proof as validating a genuine operator source. Inspected functions accept caller-constructed strings; constructor generates a review UUID, and gate checks presence/source label/fixture markers plus passed artifact-bound validation. These checks do not independently establish authenticated canonical receipt provenance. No production bypass is asserted from these excerpts.
findings.counterexample: A caller supplies plausible operator_id, receipt_id and operator_review_receipt strings without fixture keywords. Shape validation alone cannot distinguish those values from an authenticated enrolled policy or actual canonical review.
findings.correction: Replace the genuine-source proof claim with exact shape/validation checks. Both manual and policy variants require host-authenticated principal plus canonical immutable approval or policy reference, current enrollment/resource grant and author separation. Resolve that evidence through the actual owning host path; proposal fields never construct approval authority. Deny a valid-looking nonexistent or wrong-principal receipt.
findings.proof: Actual host requests with forged but plausible evidence, another principal's policy, nonexistent receipt and changed artifact/precondition fail before authority writes; canonical authorized receipt read independently proves provenance.

findings.finding: The inspected baseline contains both legacy promotion.rs and typed kb003_promotion PromotionGate/evidence, plus DCC approval control state. A new source label in only the cited legacy gate cannot establish consistent UI/API/typed-receipt behavior.
findings.counterexample: Host policy approves a proposal, but typed gate or DCC still requires a manual receipt; alternatively a shim sets approval_received without a genuine typed decision and bypasses the canonical gate.
findings.correction: Declare the actual production PromotionGate consumer and reconcile legacy/typed interfaces, approval evidence/decision/receipt, DCC Inbox/control state, API/model/headless and manual diagnostics under that owner. A policy variant is a proposed platform contract change and remains disabled until independently accepted; do not edit or redefine other-device WP012 contracts or pointers.
findings.proof: Trace installed GUI/model/headless policy and manual decisions through the same production owner; OFF/unsupported path cannot promote. Exact typed receipts preserve operator-policy provenance without counterfeit manual-review fields.

findings.finding: Per-proposal diff limits and expiry checks do not define cumulative enrollment allowance or concurrent consumption semantics. A mutable validator profile or proposal payload after review also defeats a genuine policy decision unless bound.
findings.counterexample: Two concurrent proposals each meet a policy's remaining edit/byte quota, both pass checks, and collectively exceed its allowance; retry double-consumes quota. Policy revoke or validator change races final promotion.
findings.correction: Bind approval to policy version/digest, authenticated principal/resource/action, exact proposal/artifact digest, target read/write revisions, validator run/catalog/version and inverse evidence. If policy has cumulative allowances, reserve/consume with accepted mutation and dedup receipt under canonical serialization; identical retry never consumes twice. Revoke/version/precondition changes before acceptance deny; unknown atomic outcome reconciles before any retry. Policy enrollment/update/revoke itself requires host operator authority.
findings.proof: Concurrent quota exhaustion, identical retry, policy revoke during queue/commit, validator/payload/inverse substitution and postcommit ack failure independently reconcile exact accepted events, policy usage and receipts.

findings.finding: KernelEventType wire list, dot-namespaced Studio event_family, FR-EVT-STUDIO business IDs and FlightRecorderEventType storage categories are distinct contracts. required_first_slice_events parsing proves accepted enum names, not strict payload/schema validation. Generic kernel mirror currently emits Diagnostic/System projection metadata, which is not the promised business registration.
findings.counterexample: All22 names parse but business payload validation is absent; a diagnostic kernel mirror is counted as the business family, or family generation changes wire IDs without an explicit mapping.
findings.correction: Publish an explicit bijective or declared many-to-one mapping for each of the22 canonical wire variants to exact FR business ID, version/payload schema, Studio event_family and actual recorder storage category/actor/producer. Extend existing typed FR registry and its machine manifest together; preserve generic mirror diagnostics as a separate projection if retained, never as business fulfillment. Validate payload schemas at actual ingestion, not only enum parser.
findings.proof: Exact22-set reconciliation across canonical spec, kernel required list, FR typed registry/manifest, ingestion schema and actual producer; malformed payload/version and ambiguous or missing mappings deny. Independent canonical FR row read verifies business identity rather than merely Diagnostic kernel mirror existence.

findings.finding: The inspected native-editor path writes pending before FR and only then completion, a useful standalone telemetry precedent. Studio mutation plus mirror intent must be atomic with accepted authority; merely writing an authority receipt and later scheduling pending leaves a crash window. Bounded queues also cannot drop accepted mirror intent during outage.
findings.counterexample: Authority commit succeeds, crash occurs before pending creation; restart has no durable work item to mirror. During a prolonged FR outage, a bounded preview-style queue drops accepted business events or blocks cancellation.
findings.correction: Accepted Studio transaction durably binds immutable mirror intent or a replayable canonical event sufficient to derive it, together with event/head/idempotency outcome. Shared host reconciler uses bounded fair paginated work, reserved cancellation and poison-row isolation; accepted intent remains durable until exact matching FR row plus completion. Declare durable retention/backlog admission semantics and outage recovery, with no silent drop or premature mirrored label.
findings.proof: Crash immediately after authority commit, before pending dispatch, during FR insert and before completion; prolonged outage exceeding resident queue cap; poison first row with later valid row. Canonical authority-to-FR identity reconciliation proves no missing or duplicate accepted business events.

findings.target: FR business versus three-tier diagnostics and privacy
findings.finding: Business event registration and safe callback handoff do not assign internal_diagnostics/Palmistry/watcher and per-behavior manual posture. Actor/document IDs, revisions and artifact refs in mirrors remain protected metadata; workspace filtering alone does not prove current resource grants or bounded privacy-safe payloads.
findings.counterexample: A module emits correct business events but a native plugin hang has no watcher/recovery/manual link; diagnostic payload copies private state or artifact URLs which a revoked viewer can access.
findings.correction: Each observable behavior declares separate business emitter, production FR diagnostic, internal_diagnostics, Palmistry/watcher and manual/model recovery consumer using existing owners and shared typed ports. Bind per-tier applicability/blocker and independent asset-local versus actual embedding proof. Diagnostic paths use bounded redacted metadata and counters; no secret/pixel/plugin-state payload by default. Protected event/artifact reads reauthorize current principal/resource grants; no raw artifact paths granting access.
findings.proof: Real host fault/cancel/hang and recovery appears through applicable diagnostic tiers and canonical manual/Argus; cross-principal and mid-revocation event/artifact access denied; saturated callback telemetry has exact drop/discontinuity accounting without claiming lossless diagnostic success.

other_decisions: Undo/event/raster direction read for context only; no exhaustive independent acceptance or implementation verdict. Existing plugin-platform normative controls remain separately reviewed.

findings.quote: Every planned platform and Studio foundation MUST expose its executable minimum before domain features begin
findings.finding: Unqualified platform-foundation plus actual-production proof wording can gate all pure asset domain development on the unfinished shared host lifecycle, contrary to explicit operator phase scope and STU-ARC-006.
findings.correction: Require executable portable platform/provider adapter minima with bounded supported/unsupported consumer paths in the asset foundation barrier. Real shared host install/consent/activate/revoke/lifecycle and production authorization/sandbox/state/Argus/UserManual proof are hard predecessors for actual plugin activation and corresponding host embedding, not unrelated pure asset feature development. HSK-PLG-001 missing lifecycle remains real and is not waived.

findings.quote: Use clean realms across trust boundaries
findings.finding: This names account/resource isolation but does not explicitly prevent same-document repeated evaluations from carrying mutated prototypes/global/closure/host state across ticks. MOT076 separately forbids evaluation-order dependence, so explicit provider control is required.
findings.correction: Require fresh evaluation state for each independent sample/evaluation or independently proven complete reset isolating all mutable globals/prototypes/closures/host memoization. Immutable trusted compiled artifacts may be reused; retries share allowance and exact immutable inputs. Same-document/same-account reversed frame order and fresh-versus-reused worker must conform, not merely cross-account tests.

findings.finding: Acceptance is ambiguous beside CON014 selection/proposal/rejection events which expressly do not claim document promotion. A consumer can require PromotionDecision Accepted and omit proposal/rejection audit events, or emit undurable view telemetry as accepted business authority.
findings.correction: Define the boundary by event class: accepted document mutations mirror only after canonical promotion/event transaction; proposal/rejection/view audit business events mirror only after their own canonical typed record/event is durably accepted, without implying document promotion. Transient uncommitted previews remain distinct bounded diagnostics; same durable mirror-intent/retry/collision controls apply to all required business rows.

final_root_normative_review.supported: All six original openchallenge corrections are represented in CON011/013/014. Exact22 business rows preserve wire identities and existing dot-family vocabulary; planned Studio recorder category explicitly remains unimplemented. MOT258 names MotionJS parser/AST/checkpoint ownership, trusted cache identity, constructor/prototype hostile proof, single-owner reclamation and conversion budgets; source-only/runtime distinctions remain explicit.
